headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Junior designer experienced in social media creatives, high-volume digital assets, and brand consistency.

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Social/marketing creative, typography, colour systems, layout, visual identity, print production

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives including employee engagement, branding, recruitment, and onboarding materials.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Managed print-ready file preparation covering bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy for marketing collateral.
Collaborated with HR and management stakeholders to maintain consistent visual identity across corporate communications.

Conducted usability testing and applied findings to user flows and interface usability.
Created wireframes and prototypes for product visuals using Photoshop and Illustrator.

projects.name: Social Campaign for Fashion Brand
bullets: Designed an Instagram and Facebook series that generated a 15% increase in follower engagement.
Translated campaign briefs into engaging visual content aligned with social trends.
